ground_truth.description: The marker-based _extract_inline_script matches the first <script> body containing the sentinel using a regex that does not parse HTML comments, so a commented-out <script> block containing 'mergeQueueDepthChart' is returned before the real partial script. This is a real correctness weakness (self-documented and asserted by test_sentinel_in_commented_script_is_still_matched), though unlikely to bite given real rendered HTML.

provenance.runs_db_query: SELECT task_id, project_id, outcome, review_cycles, verify_attempts FROM task_results WHERE review_cycles >= 1, cross-referenced with events (escalation_created, merge_finalized) -- see mining.mine_fn_candidates.
